note: GENERATED by scripts/sync-addons.mjs in abap2UI5/app-template - do not edit. The addons `npm run add-addon -- <repo>` knows: what each is for and depends on (from the addon catalogue, https://abap2ui5-addons.github.io/addons.json) and what abaplint can clone it at (default branch, a 702 branch, the release tags - from each repository's refs).

addons.tagline: Browse and filter table content: the classic SE16N in the browser.
addons.useWhen: Install it when the user wants to browse and filter the content of any table in the browser, instead of writing a table browser app.

addons.tagline: Add, edit, copy and delete table entries, no SAP GUI needed.
addons.useWhen: Install it when the user wants to add, edit, copy or delete the entries of a database table (SM30 style), instead of writing a maintenance app per table.

addons.tagline: Type a query, see the result as a table, keep the history.
addons.useWhen: Install it when the user wants to run an SQL query in the browser and see the result as a table, instead of writing a query app.

addons.tagline: Upload, edit and download table content as JSON, CSV or XLSX.
addons.useWhen: Install it when the user wants to move table content between systems as JSON, CSV or XLSX files, instead of writing upload and download apps.

addons.tagline: Create, release and import Transports of Copies with one click.
addons.useWhen: Install it when the user wants to create, release and import Transports of Copies from one list; it is a finished app, nothing to call from app code.

addons.tagline: Write apps like classic reports: selection screen, WRITE list, ALV.
addons.useWhen: Use when the app is a classic report - a selection screen, then a WRITE list or an ALV with drilldown - or when an existing report is moved to ABAP Cloud: inherit from z2ui5_cl_cgui_report instead of building the selection screen, the list and the grid as views by hand.

addons.tagline: Select-options with saved variants, from a table name or your data.
addons.useWhen: Use before hand-building select-options, a filter bar with ranges or saved selection variants: it builds one select-option per field of a table or of your data, inline or as a popup, and turns the result into a SQL WHERE clause or a filter of an internal table.

addons.tagline: Ready-to-use popups and dialogs, one factory( ) call each.
addons.useWhen: Use before hand-building a confirm, inform, select, decide, input, text, file upload or download, table, message, range, value help, search help, PDF or HTML dialog: each one is a finished class, called with client->nav_app_call( <class>=>factory( ... ) ), and its result is read through z2ui5_if_popup_result.

addons.tagline: Tables and forms users lay out themselves and save as variants.
addons.useWhen: Use before hand-building column personalization, sorting or saved layout variants for a table or a form: it renders an internal table or a structure with a settings button, and the user saves the layout as a variant.

addons.tagline: Fiori-elements-style apps for CDS views, generated at runtime.
addons.useWhen: Use when the app is a list report, worklist, tree, object page, overview page or value help over a CDS view with UI annotations: one floorplan class builds it at runtime, instead of writing the views by hand - experimental, Standard ABAP 7.58 or higher.

addons.tagline: Thirteen ready-to-use custom controls, one builder class each.
addons.useWhen: Use before writing a custom control or frontend JavaScript for a signature pad, a Chart.js chart, a barcode or a camera barcode scanner, a spreadsheet export, form validation, a product tour, Markdown, a code editor or a rich text editor: each control is one builder class with a render( ) method.

addons.tagline: Show an app in Excel's task pane and read and write the workbook.
addons.useWhen: Use when an app has to run inside the task pane of Microsoft Excel and read or write the workbook; a proof of concept, set up on the system and in Excel, nothing to call from app code beyond the core's z2ui5.cc.ExcelBridge control.

addons.tagline: Run an app inside your UI5 app, Fiori elements page or Work Zone card.
addons.useWhen: Use when an abap2UI5 app has to run inside an existing UI5 app, a Fiori elements page or a Work Zone card: the npm package @abap2ui5/embed-control goes into that UI5 app, the ABAP app class stays unchanged.

addons.tagline: Run an app in any web page as the custom element <abap2ui5-app>.
addons.useWhen: Use when an abap2UI5 app has to run in a web page without the UI5 core - React, Vue, Angular or plain HTML - as the custom element <abap2ui5-app>; the ABAP app class stays unchanged and has to keep to the controls of the portable view profile.

addons.tagline: A native iOS and Android app that runs your apps, with scanner, push and biometrics.
addons.useWhen: Use when the apps have to run in a native iOS or Android shell with the device's barcode scanner, push notifications or biometrics; a proof of concept, built with Xcode or Android Studio, nothing to install in ABAP.

addons.tagline: Call abap2UI5 apps on another system via RFC.
addons.useWhen: Install it when the users of one system have to run the abap2UI5 apps of another system over an RFC destination; a system setup, the apps stay unchanged.

addons.tagline: Call abap2UI5 apps on another system via HTTP.
addons.useWhen: Install it when the users of one system have to run the abap2UI5 apps of another system over an HTTP destination; a system setup, the apps stay unchanged.

addons.tagline: Show KPIs of your apps on Fiori Launchpad tiles.
addons.useWhen: Use when an app has to show a live number on a Fiori Launchpad tile: implement z2ui5_if_lp_kpi~count in the app class instead of writing an OData service for the $count call of the tile.

addons.tagline: Template for your own controls, icon fonts and CSS, in your own BSP.
addons.useWhen: Use when an app needs frontend artefacts of the user's own company - a UI5 reuse library, an icon font, corporate CSS, a custom control: fork this template and load them with z2ui5_cl_ccc=>render( ), instead of patching abap2UI5 or its frontend BSP.

addons.tagline: An MCP endpoint in ABAP: AI agents operate your apps as the real user.
addons.useWhen: Use when AI agents have to operate an app as the SAP user through MCP, or when an app needs an in-app copilot or generative UI: opt the app in with z2ui5_if_agent_app instead of writing a second API for it.

addons.tagline: Keep the settings of the abap2UI5 page in tables, not in code.
addons.useWhen: Use when theme, UI5 bootstrap source, custom CSS or the Content-Security-Policy of the abap2UI5 page have to be changed at runtime: read them with z2ui5_cl_config_service in the z2ui5_if_ui5_exit class instead of hard-coding them there.

addons.tagline: Hold a real SAP lock across the roundtrips of a stateless app.
addons.useWhen: Use when an app has to hold a real SAP enqueue lock across roundtrips, which a stateless app loses after every request: call z2ui5_cl_lock_manager=>request( ) instead of an ENQUEUE function module or a lock table of your own.

addons.tagline: Usage, errors, performance and a security traffic light at a glance.
addons.useWhen: Install it when administrators need usage, errors, response times, drafts and a security check of an abap2UI5 installation, instead of writing monitoring apps; a finished app, nothing to call from app code.

addons.tagline: Drive and test apps from ABAP. No browser, no UI5, no HTTP.
addons.useWhen: Use when writing ABAP Unit tests for an app: z2ui5_cl_frontend_sim plays the browser - sets values, fires events, reads the view and the messages - instead of a hand-written double of the client.
